MEL ONE repairs existing timber stairs, steps, handrails and balustrades in Adelaide. We distinguish a split tread or loose fixing from damage to stringers, platform supports or the whole stair, then agree local repairs and any assessed structural work.

Timber stair handrail and post repair in progress

Split Stair Treads and Loose Timber Steps

A cracked back-step edge, moving tread and worn finish need different repair decisions. The tread is the walking surface, the riser is the upright face where present, and stringers are the inclined supports. MEL ONE assesses the affected part and its fixing and support before comparing local repair with component replacement.

Do not repeatedly test unstable steps or use a visibly unsafe area while arranging assessment. A sound-looking replacement tread will still depend on the retained support and connections. Damage to stringers, a moving platform or widespread decay needs a separately resolved structural scope rather than being assumed in a small tread repair.

Handrail or Balustrade: Understand the Safety Role

A handrail provides graspable support, while a balustrade forms a protective barrier at an edge or alongside a stair. A loose handrail fixing and a moving barrier post can involve different components and consequences. Assess posts, rails, balusters and the material receiving each fixing according to their intended role.

A handrail that moves when used needs its connection checked, not simply a cosmetic cover. Seriously loose barriers should have access restricted until assessed. Safety-related repair and any altered system require the relevant design and professional responsibilities; decorative appearance does not establish the barrier's performance.

Timber Components, Connections and Structural Assessment

The agreed repair can include replacement of confirmed damaged components and failed connections. Check the retained timber receiving a new fixing before choosing hardware or adding screws. Replacement profile, dimensions and weight need consideration with the existing stair or rail arrangement.

Load-bearing stringers, platform supports or a shifted stair require the repair approach, temporary-support sequence and responsible professional assessment to be confirmed before alteration. Local tread replacement does not establish that all concealed supporting timber is sound. Record inspection limits and any further investigation needed before the work is priced as a complete remedy.

Stair Finish, Slip Treatment and Occupied-home Access

Replacement timber and retained surfaces can differ in colour, weathering and coating history. Discuss compatible preparation and protection, with local finishing and broader recoating quoted distinctly. A non-slip treatment affects the surface and does not restore damaged supports or loose safety-critical connections.

Explain whether the stair is a main entrance or internal route and what alternative access exists during repair. Agree protection, work areas and the handover condition before booking. Review the repaired components and their operation against the agreed scope, while keeping separately arranged design or specialist checks clear.

Plan a specified entrance access improvement

Local Stair Repairs and Complete Rebuild Quotes

A single tread, several barrier components and a rebuilt flight are different quantities and responsibilities. The quote should identify retained supports, replacement components, connections, access, removal, waste, finish and professional interfaces. Changes to the layout or complete stair reconstruction need a separate confirmed project brief.

Restricted access, matching components and an alternative route during work can change the allowance. Compare these with agreed support and connection repairs. If opening up reveals more damage, agree added work and price before proceeding; at handover, review repaired components and record remaining finish or professional checks.

Stair Components, Loose Barriers and Tread Replacement Questions

What is the difference between a stair tread and a stringer?

A tread is the walking surface; a stringer supports the steps along the stair. Damage to a stringer is not covered simply by replacing a tread and should be assessed as a structural concern.

Why is a loose timber balustrade more than a cosmetic repair?

A balustrade acts as a protective barrier. Loose posts, decayed timber or failed connections can affect that role, so severely loose areas should have use restricted and be assessed before the repair scope is agreed.

Can a damaged tread be replaced without rebuilding the staircase?

Local replacement may be suitable when the retained supports and surrounding components are assessed as appropriate. A full flight rebuild, damaged stringer or moving platform is a separate scope, not automatically included in a tread repair.

Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs Adelaide

MEL ONE Carpentry repairs existing cupboard doors, drawers and associated cabinet timber in Adelaide. We check whether a dropped door or failing drawer runner is a hardware problem, a damaged fixing point or deterioration in the board before agreeing the repair.

Request a cabinet door or drawer repair quote0403 202 949

Cabinet Hinges Pulled Out: Hardware and Damaged Boards

A cupboard door that drops, rubs or closes unevenly can have loose hardware, a damaged mounting area or an alignment fault. MEL ONE Carpentry checks the hinge, mounting plate, cabinet and the board receiving the fixing. Adjustment may suit a sound assembly, but a new hinge alone will not repair unsuitable material behind it.

Some local hinge fixing areas can be repaired where enough suitable board remains. Swelling, splitting or extensive damage may require separately scoped board repair or replacement. A dropped door beneath a sink also needs the moisture source considered, with plumbing responsibilities kept distinct from cabinet carpentry.

Drawer Runners Failing or Repeatedly Leaving the Track

A drawer that jams, tilts or falls off its runners needs the runner system and drawer box checked together. The fault can involve alignment, loose fixings, damaged hardware or an out-of-square box, even when the drawer is not overloaded. Inspect the front position and mounting arrangement before choosing adjustment or replacement.

Compatible replacement hardware depends on the existing system, dimensions, fixing positions and intended function. Similar appearance does not establish that a runner or soft-close mechanism will fit. Confirm parts availability and whether the drawer or cabinet needs modification to accept a different system before ordering.

Cupboard Repair and Cabinetry Replacement

A damaged hinge, door or drawer does not automatically justify replacing the kitchen. Local repair may be suitable when the retained cabinet and adjacent fixing areas are appropriate. Where the box or board has deteriorated, list that material work separately so a hardware allowance does not conceal the underlying fault.

New manufacture, a changed kitchen layout and wider installation projects belong with MEL ONE's cabinetry service. The same distinction applies to wardrobes and fitted storage. Compare the cost and achievable appearance of the accepted local repair with any separately specified replacement rather than assuming every surface will match existing aged finishes.

Plan new kitchen or laundry cabinetry

Hardware Supply, Finishing and Operation Checks

Identify whether MEL ONE or the owner supplies the agreed hinges, runners or other parts and confirm the correct specification. Include any removal, replacement board, door-front adjustment and making-good needed for the repair. Plumbing, electrical work and unrelated specialist tasks remain separate responsibilities.

At completion, review opening and closing, alignment, drawer travel and applicable soft-close or locking functions within the repaired assembly. A successful runner adjustment does not establish that unrelated cabinet damage has been remedied. Coating, colour matching and wider finish repairs need explicit inclusions in the quote.

Cabinet Repair Quote: Hardware, Board Repairs and Finishing

Ask the quote to separate adjustment, replacement hinges or runners, cabinet-board repairs and parts supply. Include removal, disposal, making-good and any coating work. The hardware specification and board condition determine whether a local repair can retain the existing door or drawer.

Discontinued hardware or damaged board can change an adjustment into a parts or material repair. Agree the replacement system, any cabinet modification and revised price before proceeding. At completion, review door alignment, drawer travel and fitted hardware, with separately arranged coating or plumbing work recorded.

Hinge Fixings, Drawer Runners and Small Repair Questions

Can damaged cabinet hinge holes be repaired?

Some local fixing areas can be repaired when sufficient suitable material remains. Swollen board or extensive damage around the hinge may require a separately scoped board repair or replacement; a new hinge alone may not resolve it.

Why does a kitchen drawer keep falling off its runners?

Runner damage, alignment, loose fixings or the drawer box can contribute. MEL ONE checks the assembly and compatible parts before agreeing adjustment or runner replacement rather than assuming overloading is the only cause.

Does MEL ONE Carpentry handle a small cupboard repair?

Yes. MEL ONE Carpentry assesses cupboard door, drawer, hardware and associated cabinet material repairs. A changed kitchen layout or new cabinetry is a different project brief.
